title: Reproducing the Speech Labels of Qwen3-Omni's Talker: Mimi in bf16, and a Last-Frame Pitfall
abstract: arXiv:2611.32286v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Qwen3-Omni speaks through a Talker predicting 16 codebooks of a 12.5 Hz audio codec, but the encoder that made its training labels was not released, so new voices cannot be trained on matching labels. We identify this encoder from the released model's behavior. White-box regression shows that the codebook embeddings of the Talker, its multi-token predictor and the Code2Wav decoder match the first 16 codebooks of kyutai's Mimi layer by layer. A decoder-based test looks convincing but fails calibration: decoders trained on known labels cannot tell them apart. Teacher-forced Talker likelihoods, calibrated with 13 code language models trained on known labels, do tell implementations apart: the Talker prefers labels from kyutai's moshi package with bf16 weights over every other variant we tried. translated_title: 复现Qwen3-Omni的Talker语音标签：bf16精度的Mimi，以及一个最后一帧陷阱
translated_abstract: Qwen3-Omni通过一个Talker（说话模块）进行语音合成，该模块预测12.5 Hz音频编解码器的16个码本，但生成其训练标签的编码器并未开源，因此无法在匹配的标签上训练新的声音。作者从已发布模型的行为中识别出了这个编码器。白盒回归表明，Talker、其多词预测器以及Code2Wav解码器的码本嵌入与kyutai的Mimi的前16个码本逐层匹配。一种基于解码器的测试看似有说服力，但未通过校准检验：在已知标签上训练的解码器无法区分不同实现。而使用13个在已知标签上训练的代码语言模型进行校准后的教师强制Talker似然则能够区分各实现：相比作者尝试的所有其他变体，Talker更偏好来自kyutai的moshi包且使用bf16权重的标签。响度归一化以及对20%及以上数据的频带限制均被排除。此外，transformers库中的MimiModel对最后一帧的编码方式存在差异……
tldr: 本文通过白盒回归与校准后的教师强制似然分析，确定Qwen3-Omni的Talker训练标签来自kyutai的Mimi编解码器（moshi包、bf16精度），并揭示了transformers库中MimiModel最后一帧编码不一致的陷阱。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the unreleased speech-label encoder of Qwen3-Omni's Talker as kyutai's Mimi (moshi package, bf16 weights) via white-box regression and calibrated teacher-forced likelihood tests, while also exposing a last-frame encoding pitfall in transformers' MimiModel.
